causal.description: Attention flow analysis reveals a critical 3-hop causal chain: ASML's EUV Scanner technology gates TSMC's advanced process capability, which exclusively enables Apple's A17 Pro chip. Disruption at any node cascades to downstream.
evidence: No alternative path exists at comparable strength
causal.title: 3-hop dependency: EUV Scanner -> TSMC -> A17 Pro -> Apple

causal.description: Betweenness centrality analysis identifies Taiwan as the most critical information bottleneck (centrality: 0.41). Simulated removal fragments the graph into 3 disconnected components, isolating 67% of chip production from tool suppliers.
causal.title: Taiwan identified as single point of failure

causal.description: Simulated removal of Neon Gas entity causes a 34% drop in predictive accuracy for the 5nm GAA and 3nm MBCFET process nodes, revealing a hidden material dependency not captured by direct edges.
causal.title: Neon gas supply disruption propagates to 5nm processes

causal.description: The strongest combined attention+adjacency pathway runs from Silicon Wafer through CVD Chamber to 7nm FinFET, with a cumulative strength of 0.91.
evidence: Path: Silicon Wafer -> CVD Chamber -> 7nm FinFET
causal.title: Strongest causal link: Silicon Wafer -> 7nm FinFET (strength 0.91)

deep_signals.description: The energy landscape shows a sharp gradient between the Company cluster (centroid energy 0.018) and the Chip cluster (0.024), indicating a strong predictive boundary. 20 companies and 15 chips form a tightly coupled supply-demand axis.
evidence: Fisher trace peaks at cluster interface
deep_signals.title: Energy concentration in Company-Chip interface

deep_signals.description: Langevin exploration found a significant blank space (score 0.87) between the Materials and Process clusters, suggesting hidden supply chain dependencies that the current model cannot predict. This region may contain novel manufacturing constraints.
deep_signals.title: Unexplored region between Materials and Processes

deep_signals.description: Aggregated attention weights reveal TSMC as the highest out-degree node (fan-out: 23 entities), acting as the central information relay in the semiconductor supply chain graph.
deep_signals.title: TSMC identified as primary attention hub (80 entities analyzed)

meta.description: The learned representations use 4.2 of 8 available dimensions effectively (52.5% utilization). Uniformity score: 0.83 (well-distributed). Neighborhood preservation: 0.91 (local structure intact). These metrics indicate a high-quality embedding suitable for downstream routing.
meta.title: Representation effective rank: 4.2 (good for 8D space)

meta.description: Of the 80 entities in the semiconductor supply chain, 87% fall within the coverage radius of at least one crystallized module. The remaining 13% (10 entities) are in the Material-Process interface void identified by the topological engine.
meta.title: Corpus coverage: 87% (80 entities modeled)

meta.description: Current crystallization produced 5 modules against a trading preset maximum of 48. The model has 43 slots available for additional structure discovery. Recommendation: increase Langevin exploration steps to discover the Material-Process boundary modules.
meta.title: Model capacity assessment: 5 modules, 48 max (trading preset)

oracle.description: The crystallized module structure reveals that all sub-5nm process nodes depend on a single EUV Scanner supply chain through ASML (Netherlands). The attractor module centered on EUV Scanner has purity 0.94 and contains 15 dependent entities. Risk mitigation: diversify lithography sourcing or stockpile critical components.
oracle.title: OPERATIONAL BRIEF: Single-source risk in advanced lithography

oracle.description: The Chiplet Assembly process node is positioned at the boundary of 3 modules (boundary module, purity 0.78), indicating it serves as a cross-cutting capability. Its routing score has been increasing across crystallization cycles, suggesting growing structural importance. Early-mover advantage in chiplet-compatible tools and materials.
oracle.title: INVESTMENT BRIEF: Chiplet assembly as emerging structural node

oracle.description: The crystallized modules cleanly separate into a Taiwan-Korea-US super-cluster and a China-adjacent cluster, with SMIC as the sole bridge entity. Module purity drops from 0.94 to 0.72 at the boundary, indicating the decoupling is structurally real but not yet complete.
oracle.title: GEOPOLITICAL BRIEF: US-China decoupling visible in module structure

temporal.description: The representation underwent a phase transition at epoch 28: module count jumped from 4 to 8 in a single crystallization cycle, effective rank dropped from 6.1 to 4.2, and the convergence score spiked before stabilizing. This corresponds to the model discovering the Tool-Material boundary.
temporal.title: Structural phase transition at epoch 28

temporal.description: Representation velocity analysis shows Country entities drifting toward the Company cluster at 0.12 units/epoch, suggesting the model is learning that country-level factors (trade policy, subsidies) are predictive of company behavior.
temporal.title: Topic drift: Country entities migrating toward Company cluster

topological.description: Persistent homology (H2) detected a topological void between the Tool cluster (15 entities) and Material cluster (12 entities). This void indicates a structural gap in the supply chain model — the relationship between manufacturing tools and their required materials is under-represented.
topological.title: H2 void detected between Tool and Material clusters

topological.description: A persistent 1-cycle (H1) reveals a feedback loop: Companies invest in Processes that require specialized Tools, which in turn are co-developed with the same Companies. This cycle has persistence 0.58, indicating moderate stability.
topological.title: H1 cycle: Company -> Process -> Tool -> Company

topological.description: Connected component analysis (H0) at 3 filtration scales reveals 5 stable modules. The Company-Chip super-cluster merges first (scale 0.3), while Country entities remain isolated until scale 0.8, reflecting their role as contextual rather than functional nodes.
topological.title: Multi-scale H0 analysis: 5 stable modules at 3 resolution levels

uncertainty.description: Epistemic uncertainty quantification identifies 10 entities in the Material-Process interface as poorly modeled (mean uncertainty: 0.73, vs corpus mean: 0.21). These entities would benefit from additional training data or a targeted Langevin exploration pass.
uncertainty.title: High uncertainty region: Material-Process interface (13% of entities)

uncertainty.description: 87% of supply chain entities fall within the coverage radius of at least one crystallized module. This is a strong result for a 100-entity graph with 5 clusters and indicates the module factory has captured the dominant structure.
uncertainty.title: Overall coverage ratio: 0.87 (87% of entities within module radius)
